description: Na₂BaFe₄F₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.70 Å. Ba is bonded to twelve F atoms to form BaF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with eight FeF₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.82-2.91 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six FeF₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent BaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-34°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.15 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six FeF₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent BaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-34°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.16 Å. There are eight inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to one Na, one Ba, and two Fe atoms to form distorted FBaNaFe₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent FBaNa₂Fe₂ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent FBaNaFe₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FBaNa₂Fe₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the second F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Ba, and two Fe atoms to form distorted FBaNa₂Fe₂ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FBaNa₂Fe₂ trigonal bipyramid, corners with four equivalent FBaNaFe₂ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FBaNa₂Fe₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one FBaNaFe₂ trigonal pyramid. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, and two Fe atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ba, and two Fe atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Ba and two equivalent Fe atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ba, and two equivalent Fe atoms. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Ba and two equivalent Fe atoms. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ba, and two equivalent Fe atoms.
